catalogue_metadata.scope_notes: Extracted from Continuous Architecture Steering (CAS) runner, governance engine, and agent steering subsystems.
analysis_limits: Based on available Python codebase and architecture documentation trees
Dynamic prompt templates in cas-knowledge were analysed via structural schema references

system_map.overview: ideas-to-life-cas is an agentic continuous architecture steering platform that converts git deltas and repository facts into validated architectural state changes via structured agent pipelines and deterministic governance guardrails.

agents.name: AgenticMerger
agents.role: Evaluates architectural and repository deltas to merge steering specifications into governed workspace representations.

agents.name: ComplianceEngine
agents.role: Evaluates repository context and agent-proposed mutations against architectural rules and compliance policies.

orchestration.description: Centralised orchestration coordinated by FlowRunner, driving multi-step pipelines and transition enforcement through GovernanceActionEngine.

tools_and_integrations.name: LiteLLM Gateway
tools_and_integrations.purpose: Provides unified access to underlying LLM model providers with mock fallbacks for testing.

tools_and_integrations.name: OpenTelemetry Instrumentation
tools_and_integrations.purpose: Emits telemetry spans and execution traces for compliance evaluation and drift detection.

state_and_memory.description: File-based knowledge store and architecture records residing under cas-knowledge tracking decisions, patterns, and rules.
In-memory indexed capabilities and architectural deltas derived from git changes.

patterns.name: Provider-Agnostic LLM Gateway

tool_protocols.notes: Abstracts invocation via litellm with structured response parsing.

optimisation_targets.notes: Decouples business agents from LLM provider quirks and enables test mocking.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Direct client abstraction without dynamic routing complexity.

patterns.summary: Encapsulates LLM invocation behind a unified interface with interchangeable concrete and mock providers.
patterns.intent: Decouple agentic components from vendor-specific LLM implementations while enabling zero-cost deterministic offline execution.
patterns.context: Used across governance actions and compliance checks where agents require inference without hardcoded API clients.
forces: Need multi-model routing flexibility vs. predictable response schema
Need offline CI testing without active cloud LLM credentials
patterns.solution: Define an abstraction client backed by LiteLLM alongside a MockLLMClient adhering to the same interface contract.
implementation_signals: Existence of LiteLLMClient and MockLLMClient sharing common completion patterns
Parameterised client selection in runner execution context

evidence.note: Provides deterministic responses for test pipelines

benefits: Seamless switching between local, mock, and commercial LLMs
costs: Additional indirection layer over provider-specific bleeding-edge features
failure_modes: Underlying LiteLLM model string mismatch or unmapped vendor error formats

patterns.reuse_notes: Can be ported into any Python agentic runtime requiring provider parity and offline test suites.

patterns.name: Delta-Driven Prompt Fact Projection

tool_protocols.notes: Pre-processes raw git diffs into typed PromptFact structures before prompting.

optimisation_targets.notes: Reduces context window token overhead by compiling diffs into verified architectural facts.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Automates delta extraction but enforces strict dataclass boundaries before agent ingestion.

patterns.summary: Transforms raw code repository changes into typed PromptFact and ArchitecturalDelta models before agent ingestion.
patterns.intent: Prevent LLM hallucinations and context bloat by grounding agent inputs in verified, typed code changes.
patterns.context: Used in steering ingestion to prepare minimal, high-signal context for agentic architecture analysis.
forces: Large raw git diffs exceed context limits and degrade instruction following
Agents need structural context (capabilities, lineage) rather than raw text diffs
patterns.solution: Parse repository deltas into RawGitDelta and index them into CapabilitySet and PromptFact before invoking agents.
implementation_signals: Models for RawGitDelta, ArchitecturalDelta, and PromptFact

evidence.note: Defines typed facts derived from git operations for agent ingestion

benefits: Grounds agent reasoning in concrete repository diffs
costs: Preprocessing overhead to inspect and map git changes
failure_modes: Incomplete git delta parsing can omit critical cross-file semantic shifts

patterns.reuse_notes: Adopt in systems where LLMs must review or reason about version-controlled changes.

patterns.name: State-Machine Governance Guardrail

tool_protocols.notes: Applies programmatic state machine transitions over agent outputs.

optimisation_targets.notes: Guarantees agent proposals cannot skip required lifecycle stages or bypass policies.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Rigid deterministic rule engine supersedes agent autonomy.

patterns.summary: Constrains autonomous agent actions through a deterministic state machine transition registry.
patterns.intent: Ensure that agent-proposed actions follow strict architectural lifecycle rules without uncontrolled side effects.
patterns.context: Executing governance actions and state transitions generated by agents or pipelines.
forces: Agents may propose invalid transitions or bypass approval phases
Rules must be strictly enforced regardless of LLM reasoning variations
patterns.solution: Define TransitionRegistry and GovernanceActionEngine to validate state changes before applying them to workspace assets.
implementation_signals: GovernanceException raised on unauthorized transition attempts

evidence.note: Maintains allowed transitions and executes governed operations
Defines action payload and failure types

benefits: Deterministic boundary preventing hallucinated state changes
Clear audit trail for compliance verification
costs: Every new transition must be explicitly coded into the registry
failure_modes: Overly rigid transition tables may reject novel legitimate agent workflows

patterns.reuse_notes: Ideal for enterprise agent frameworks requiring non-negotiable policy adherence.

patterns.name: Typed Compliance Synthesis Contract

tool_protocols.notes: Structures agent evaluations into validated Pydantic compliance records.

optimisation_targets.notes: Enforces typed validation on every compliance metric and finding.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: LLM produces structured findings which Pydantic rigorously validates.

patterns.summary: Enforces strict Pydantic schemas on compliance evaluations produced during architectural reviews.
patterns.intent: Convert subjective agent reviews into typed, actionable evaluation metrics.
patterns.context: Executed during automated pull request checks or scheduled governance reviews.
forces: Free-form LLM evaluation reports cannot be parsed reliably by downstream CI tooling
Evaluation findings must trace to specific repository rules and severity levels
patterns.solution: Define ComplianceFinding and ComplianceMetrics models which the ComplianceEngine populates and validates.
implementation_signals: Pydantic models ComplianceFinding, ComplianceMetrics, and TraceableMetric
ComplianceEngine methods parsing structured LLM evaluations into typed instances

evidence.note: Strongly typed models for evaluation outputs

benefits: Guaranteed downstream machine readability for dashboards and CI gates
Immediate parsing failure if agent outputs malformed fields
costs: Requires retries or robust fallback handling when LLM schema validation fails
failure_modes: Schema validation errors if LLM outputs an unexpected severity category

patterns.reuse_notes: Use Pydantic or JSONSchema to wrap any agentic audit or compliance step.

patterns.name: Agentic Merge Resolution Loop

tool_protocols.notes: Combines deterministic structural merges with agentic conflict arbitration.

optimisation_targets.notes: Handles non-trivial semantic conflicts while protecting core governance blocks.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Automates conflict reconciliation while returning structured ResolutionResult status.

patterns.summary: Resolves multi-source architectural documentation and configuration conflicts using combined heuristic and LLM logic.
patterns.intent: Resolve non-trivial architectural document and code delta conflicts without human intervention where possible.
patterns.context: Executing multi-project governance merges and synchronising managed steering repositories.
forces: Pure 3-way text diff algorithms fail on semantic Markdown or YAML changes
Unconstrained LLM merges can silently delete required governance constraints
patterns.solution: Implement AgenticMerger to evaluate merge candidates and output explicit ResolutionResult records.
implementation_signals: ResolutionResult model capturing conflict outcome, confidence, and applied changes

costs: Higher latency compared to deterministic git merges
failure_modes: Subtle loss of architectural intent if context prompt lacks preceding ADR background

patterns.reuse_notes: Applicable to documentation-as-code and architectural knowledge synchronization systems.

patterns.name: Sequential Pipeline Orchestrator

tool_protocols.notes: Sequentially invokes steps with context passing.

optimisation_targets.notes: Provides a predictable sequence of validation, planning, and execution stages.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Static sequential execution order avoids dynamic loop nondeterminism.

patterns.summary: Coordinates multi-step agent and validation flows through a centralised sequential runner with shared context propagation.
patterns.intent: Maintain explicit, inspectable control over agent execution stages and prevent uncontrolled looping.
patterns.context: Main execution entrypoint triggered by CLI or automated GitHub workflows.
forces: Autonomous agent loops can spin indefinitely or incur unexpected API costs
Deterministic pipeline stages are required for CI/CD auditability
patterns.solution: FlowRunner class executes declared pipeline steps sequentially, validating state after each stage.
implementation_signals: Sequential invocation pattern with execution profile checks

benefits: Highly predictable execution flow suitable for CI/CD
Clear boundary for step-level metrics and failure attribution
costs: Lacks flexibility for dynamic back-tracking or autonomous re-planning
failure_modes: Pipeline halts completely if an intermediate step fails without error handling

patterns.reuse_notes: Foundation for deterministic CI/CD agentic workflows.

patterns.name: Health-Model Observability Guardrail

tool_protocols.notes: Computes health telemetry and risk scores over agent metrics.

optimisation_targets.notes: Quantifies operational risk and flags architectural drift before deployment.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Applies deterministic threshold formulas to compute health status.

patterns.summary: Computes deterministic health scores and categorical risk indicators from agent execution outputs and governance inventories.
patterns.intent: Detect system degradation, governance drift, and agent performance regressions via objective scoring.
patterns.context: Dashboard and reporting modules reviewing repository and runner health.
forces: Agentic systems can degrade quietly through subtle drift in decisions
Teams need high-level status indicators (green/amber/red) derived from telemetry
patterns.solution: Define HealthStatus enum, calculate_health function, and get_health_reasons diagnostics to quantify health.
implementation_signals: GovernanceHealth and GovernanceRisks models in src/cas_runner/governance/models.py

evidence.note: Implements deterministic risk and health evaluations

benefits: Exposes drift and governance risks transparently to operators
Provides automated gate evaluation for pull requests
costs: Thresholds must be calibrated to avoid false positive alarms
failure_modes: Uncalibrated risk heuristics could mask underlying architectural violations

patterns.reuse_notes: Easily ported to provide aggregate health indices over multi-agent or agentic CI systems.

patterns.name: Deterministic Governance Injection Bootstrap

tool_protocols.notes: Manipulates workspace files to inject immutable governance headers.

optimisation_targets.notes: Guarantees governance instructions cannot be stripped by project agents.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Static regex/template injection without autonomous LLM rewriting.

patterns.summary: Injects immutable governance instructions and steering blocks into workspace files during initialization.
patterns.intent: Ensure target projects always contain mandatory system prompts and steering policies before agents run.
patterns.context: Initial workspace creation and repository onboarding via CLI.
forces: User or agent edits can accidentally delete critical system prompt steering directives
Standardized templates must be maintained across multiple target repositories
patterns.solution: Execute merge_cas_governance_block during workspace initialization to merge managed blocks into configuration files.
implementation_signals: merge_cas_governance_block and init_workspace functions in src/cas_runner/bootstrap.py

evidence.note: Merges governance blocks into target workspace files

benefits: Guarantees presence of agent instructions across external project trees
Preserves project-specific configuration while refreshing core governance
costs: Can result in file merge conflicts if target workspace modified delimiters
failure_modes: Corrupted injection markers can cause duplicated governance blocks

patterns.reuse_notes: Use to distribute and enforce shared agent instructions across multi-repo ecosystems.

anti_patterns.name: Unbounded Action Execution
symptoms: Allowing LLM agents to execute file writes or git merges without passing through TransitionRegistry validation

where_observed.note: Engine specifically implements TransitionRegistry to avoid this risk

suggested_remediation: Funnel all agent mutations through a deterministic transition validator before touching disk or git

cross_cutting_concerns.approach: Integrated OpenTelemetry SDK alongside domain-specific health and risk computation models.
cross_cutting_concerns.notes: Allows continuous tracking of agentic throughput and governance violations.

cross_cutting_concerns.approach: Pre-compiles git diffs into typed PromptFact objects before prompt rendering to ensure deterministic token representations.
cross_cutting_concerns.notes: Reduces hallucinations by enforcing factual, structured input payloads.

open_questions.question: How are LLM retries and rate limits handled across different cloud providers during peak CI runs?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Batch CI runs on large architectural deltas may exhaust rate limits if not managed by an exponential backoff policy.
open_questions.evidence_gap: LiteLLMClient wraps litellm completion but specific retry policies or backoff hooks were not explicitly detailed in key symbols.
open_questions.suggested_next_check: Inspect litellm configuration parameters and exception handlers in src/cas_runner/llm/litellm_client.py.
